detail: The separate SEC003Vite repair does not resolve mobile dependency alerts. Direct Zod4.6.7is outside the reported<4.6.6range, while Expo CLI also locks Zod3.25.76; assess affected collection-validation behavior and consumer support before forcing major3to4 or claiming a false positive. These are package/version and source-path observations, not demonstrated production exploitability or native-device behavior. Resolve compatible updates in task-owned dependency environments, preserve pinned lockfiles, exercise actual consumers and native lint/typing/pure tests, and record any genuinely unpatchable upstream limitation separately from completed repairs.
